question: What contemplative focus leads one toward the presence of Mahakala?
premises: One contemplates the matted hair tuft.
This contemplation is directed toward proximity to Mahakala.
inference: Contemplating the matted hair tuft brings one near Mahakala.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the matted hair tuft may be the goddess or Mahakala.
plain_english: Having contemplated the matted hair tuft, one approaches the presence of Mahakala.
